basic_details.job_title: MSEDCL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Company Secretary, Joint Company Secretary Posts
basic_details.short_information: One Company Secretary post and one Joint Company Secretary post are open at Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd (MSEDCL, Mahavitaran) under Advertisement No. 02 / 2026, dated 14/11/2026, for its Board level secretarial role. Applications in the prescribed format go by email to [email protected] and must be received by 17:30 hours on 20 November 2026. As of 15 November 2026, the application window is open.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be emailed to [email protected] . Applications received by any other mode, by courier or by hand will not be considered. The notice does not prescribe an email subject line. The application form also asks for: your current designation, office and pay; membership of professional bodies; details of every post held, starting with the present one, including pay and gross emoluments, perks, period and nature of duties; training undergone in India and abroad; publications and academic honours; whether you face any charge sheet or FIR for a criminal offence; the minimum time you need to join; a declaration about the number of your living children.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The number of advertised posts is provisional and likely to change. Qualification: Graduate Degree with Associate Membership of Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ACS). Preferable: Degree in Law from a Recognized University/Institute. Experience: Minimum 15 years of post-qualification experience. At least 02 (Two) years of this must be at the level of General Manager in Listed Companies having paid up capital of ₹ 100 crore or more, in a Central or State Government, Public or Private Sector Company. Terms: The initial probationary period shall be up to 12 months. After probation, the tenure will extend for five years (excluding the probationary period), subject to a performance review. Upon satisfactory review on completion of the fixed tenure, the candidate may be considered for absorption into the regular pay scale of Chief Engineer and equivalent, that is, Pay Scale of Rs. 140655-5980-272215. Experience: Minimum 12 years of post-qualification experience. At least 02 (Two) years of this must be at the level of General Manager in Listed Companies having paid up capital of ₹ 100 crore or more, in a Central or State Government, Public or Private Company. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly completed application form in the prescribed format, with your photograph pasted and the form signed. Self-attested scanned copies of your SSC certificate, qualification certificates and experience certificates issued by the relevant organization or company. Your last drawn pay slip. Your hierarchy in your organization, along with the organizational structure. Applications that are incomplete, sent without documents, not supported by self-attested copies of certificates, or not in the prescribed format are liable to be summarily rejected. The same applies to applications received after the due date. At the interview, bring the following: the original application form; photocopies of your educational and professional qualification certificates; a 'No Objection Certificate', if you work in a Govt. Department, Public Sector Undertaking or Semi Govt. Undertaking.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by shortlisting followed by a selection process/interview. Applications go through a preliminary scrutiny. Candidates are shortlisted taking into consideration qualification, experience, age, job responsibility etc. The number shortlisted will be commensurate with the number of vacancies. MSEDCL reserves the right to adopt appropriate shortlisting criteria depending on the number of applications received. Meeting the minimum pre-requisites does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called. Shortlisted applicants will be informed by email only, and no call letters will be sent by post or courier. The interview is tentatively scheduled at Mumbai on 23 November 2026. Candidates must attend in person, though in exceptional cases a candidate may take part through VC with prior approval. Candidates appear at their own expense. The Selection Committee will recommend suitable candidates. It considers domain knowledge, leadership qualities, aptitude and suitability for the post, and performance in the interview. Eligibility will be verified against original documents after the final selection process and before the offer or appointment letter is issued. Selection is also subject to verification of disciplinary actions and other service records.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MSEDCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: 1 Company Secretary and 1 Joint Company Secretary. The number of posts is provisional and likely to change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MSEDCL Company Secretary posts?
faq.answer: The application must be received by email by 17:30 hours on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for MSEDCL Company Secretary and Joint Company Secretary?
faq.answer: Both posts require a Graduate Degree with Associate Membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ACS), and a Degree in Law is preferable. Company Secretary needs a minimum of 15 years' post-qualification experience and Joint Company Secretary a minimum of 12 years, in each case with at least 2 years at General Manager level in listed companies with paid up capital of ₹ 100 crore or more.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MSEDCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 50 years as on the date of advertisement, 14/11/2026, for both posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of MSEDCL Company Secretary and Joint Company Secretary?
faq.answer: Company Secretary gets 4 to 6 lakh per month (CTC) during the fixed tenure, and Joint Company Secretary gets a fixed 3.5 to 5 lakh (CTC) per month. The notice calls these amounts suggestive.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for MSEDCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email the completed application form, with self-attested scanned copies of your SSC certificate, qualification and experience certificates, to [email protected] from your personal email ID. Applications by courier or by hand are not accepted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the MSEDCL Company Secretary posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on qualification, experience, age and job responsibility, and are then called for a selection process/interview. The interview is tentatively scheduled at Mumbai on 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is the MSEDCL Joint Company Secretary post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The Joint Company Secretary post is on contract for three years and may be extended yearly up to 05 years, with no claim to regular employment. The Company Secretary may be considered for absorption into the Chief Engineer pay scale after the fixed tenure, based on a performance review.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for both MSEDCL posts?
faq.answer: Candidates may apply for either post, and MSEDCL reserves the right to offer either post based on performance in the selection process. Only one application per post should be sent.

faq.question: Q10. Do government or PSU employees need an NOC for MSEDCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Employees of a Govt. Department, Public Sector Undertaking or Semi Govt. Undertaking must produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview.
